standard_prerequisites.name: The level one Demazure module D(1, k theta) as a cyclic graded module over the current algebra with a fixed highest weight vector
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section 3, in which the module is set up before the counted statement
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the module whose presentation by generators and relations is asserted.

standard_prerequisites.name: The relations labelled dm1 and dm2 in the article, describing the action of the negative root vectors on the highest weight vector of a Demazure module, and the relation labelled w2'

standard_prerequisites.name: The explicit defining relations of the local Weyl module W(k theta)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Recalled at the end of the counted proof (source line 441)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the remaining relations of the statement with the known presentation, which concludes the proof.

core_obligations: Root system observation: since the pairing of the highest root with any other positive root is zero or one, the corresponding pairings with k theta are zero or kd_alpha, which shows that one family of known relations does not occur for this module (proof lines 427-430)

Simplification of the known relations: the proof records what the other family becomes in this case, namely the annihilation by a twisted negative root vector for short roots paired with the highest root, and observes that for long roots the same annihilation follows from the relation labelled w2' (proof lines 430-440)
Conclude: the remaining relations listed in the statement are exactly the defining relations of the local Weyl module, which establishes the asserted presentation (proof lines 440-441)
proof_roadmap: 由根系事实：(θ|α) 对 α ∈ R^+∖{θ} 只能为 0 或 1，故 ⟨kθ, α^∨⟩ 为 0 或 kd_α；于是 dm2 那族关系在 D(1,kθ) 中不出现，dm1 化归为「短根时 (x^-_α⊗t^k)w̄ = 0」。
长根且 (θ|α)=1 时由 (w2') 同样得 (x^-_α⊗t^k)w̄ = 0；其余关系正是 W(kθ) 的定义关系，故所列关系给出 D(1,kθ) 的展示。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives an explicit presentation of the level one Demazure module D(1, k theta) by one generator and four families of relations, including the annihilation by the positive part, the action of the Cartan part, and two families for the negative root vectors (author proposition at source lines 396-425, label WvsD). The proof (source lines 426-442) uses a root system observation to see that one family of known relations does not occur, simplifies the other family using the relation labelled w2', and identifies the remaining relations with the defining relations of the local Weyl module (proof lines 427-441). The comparison of the listed relations with the known ones is the content. H2.
